items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: So we’re back there and Dick Shearer and I are trying to say, “You know come on, you sold out, we were here two nights, you sold out.” Willie Maiden brings some of the bigger guys back in there

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah I had to book all the hotels. I had to collect all the money. I had to stay in touch with Harold Plant’s office, that was the people that handled all of Stan’s finances and money and stuff. If we were getting paid in cash you had to take it — there were a couple of different banks that we used where Stan had accounts and you’d have to take it. It was really funny because sometimes we’d be out for seven or eight, nine days without getting to a bank or anything and I’d have a whole bunch of cash with me…

So I had to pretend that, oh gee I really did think Stan was going to be joining us but they just said at the last minute he can’t. So then they would, a lot of times, especially clubs and things like that, they’d try to say well you broke the contract because Stan isn’t here. And I’d say, “You sold out, we’re trying to keep this band on the road for Stan…
